description: Lead bash guard blocks 'git merge' even when coordinator mail explicitly instructs the lead to integrate sibling branches locally. The hook denies git add/commit/merge/checkout/rebase/push/reset/stash uniformly. Coordinators that ask the lead to do pre-merge integration verification will hit this constraint silently — the directive looks executable, but the harness denies it.
resolution: Standard merge-dispatch protocol still applies: when 'ov merge --dry-run --json' returns wouldRequireAgent=false for each branch, the lead sends merge_ready per branch and the coordinator processes the queue. The lead can run quality gates against its own (un-integrated) branch as a baseline sanity check, but cannot produce the integrated cargo test count. Coordinators wanting pre-merge integration verification must either (a) lift --dispatch-max-agents 0 so the lead can spawn a merger, or (b) verify post-merge themselves.

name: lead-self-verify-via-dry-run-when-merge-blocked
description: Lead self-verification path when bash guard blocks local integration: (1) git diff main..<builder-branch> --stat to confirm file scope matches spec, (2) read the diff body for the contract details called out in coordinator's brief (renamed fields, ADR-traced unsafe blocks, expected import paths), (3) ov merge --dry-run --branch <branch> --json on every branch and check wouldRequireAgent across all of them, (4) run cargo build/test/clippy/fmt on the lead's own branch as Wave-1-baseline sanity (won't validate combined surface but proves baseline is healthy and toolchain works), (5) send one merge_ready per branch with branch sha + files + dry-run prediction in the body. Combined-surface verification is left to the coordinator's ov merge queue.

name: lead-resume-after-hibernation-verify-only
description: When a lead is re-dispatched with --dispatch-max-agents 0 because its builder finished during a previous hibernation/worktree-clean window, the coordinator's mail summarises the worker_done payload (branch, commit, files, quality-gate results, ADR compliance, dry-run prediction) so the lead can self-verify by diff inspection alone. Skip reviewer/builder spawns even though the change is complex; the bash-guard 'NO reviewer sessions found' warning is expected and benign in this flow. Body the merge_ready mail with branch, commit, test count, ADR-by-ADR confirmation from your diff read, and any deviations spotted (e.g. acceptable annotation-only files, simplifications worth follow-up tickets).

name: lead-resume-hibernation-merge-ready-only-flow
description: When a lead is resurrected via the FINAL: directive (--dispatch-max-agents 0) and the coordinator's mail recapitulates the lost worker_done payload (branch, commit, files, quality-gate results, PLAN.md verbatim verification, prereq-gate enumeration, dry-run prediction), the entire lead turn collapses to: (1) cross-check the recap against the diff via git show <branch>:<file>, (2) re-run ov merge --dry-run --json --branch <branch> as a sanity check, (3) form a stance on any pre-flagged scope expansion, (4) send merge_ready citing branch+commit+filelist+stance, (5) ml record + sd close + terminal worker_done. The 'NO reviewer sessions' warning emitted by ov mail send is documented as expected in mx-dd3768 — do not let it trigger a reviewer spawn. Total turn: ~10 tool calls, no scout/builder/reviewer spawns.
